context.body: Judgment on beastly empires leads to authority granted to a human-like figure.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The Ancient of Days sits in fiery judgment, the court opens books, beasts lose dominion, and one like a son of man receives everlasting rule.
observations.label: The Ancient of Days gives dominion: action

observations.body: Heavenly attendants serve; the human-like figure approaches and receives the nations.
observations.label: The Ancient of Days gives dominion: response

payload.posture: Read Daniel 7:9–14 as future and faithfulness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The vision distinguishes the Ancient of Days from the approaching figure while binding their rule within one heavenly scene.
